articles.summary: Senior appointments from Pfizer, Novartis, Arbor Biotechnologies, and Orum Therapeutics bring preclinical development, structural biology, and portfolio strategy depth as MindWalk prepares its programs for preclinical efficacy studies MindWalk Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: HYFT) (MindWalk or the Company), a Bio-Native AI company, today announced three senior appointments that strengthen its Boston-based development leadership as the Companys pipeline advances toward preclinical efficacy studies. Zachary Maben, PhD, joins as Director, Antigen Discovery Protein Engineering, from Arbor Biotechnologies and previously Pfizer. Joanne Lim, PhD, joins as Director, Preclinical Development, from Orum Therapeutics and previously Codiak Biosciences and Novartis. Shuji Sato, PhD, Vice President, Innovative Solutions, a MindWalk veteran with prior roles at Pfizer and Dragonfly Therapeutics, expands his responsibilities to include the Companys pipeline.
articles.title: MindWalk Holdings Corp. Strengthens Boston-Based Development Leadership as Pipeline Advances Toward Preclinical Efficacy Studies

articles.summary: Veteran Banker and Licensed Fiduciary to Serve on the Audit Committee and the Compensation, Nomination and Governance Committee MindWalk Holdings Corp. ("MindWalk") (NASDAQ: HYFT), a Bio-Native AI company, today announced the appointment of Kim Remizowski to its Board of Directors as an independent director, effective September 29, 2026. Mr. Remizowski will serve on the Audit Committee and the Compensation, Nomination and Governance Committee. The Board has determined that he qualifies as an independent director under Nasdaq listing rules and as an audit committee financial expert under applicable SEC rules. With this appointment, the Board comprises four directors, three of whom are independent. Mr. Remizowski most recently served as Director, Private Equity at Vistra, a global corporate services group operating in more than 50 jurisdictions, where he oversaw governance for a portfolio of investment funds and holding structures.
